points: Survey: 1,719 respondents in 97 nations, May to June 2026
32% skipped buying software because agents could build it in-house
39% expect AI-related job cuts next year; 14% saw them in the past year
take: 40% of large firms are scaling agents, yet only 37% see any profit impact. The 6% who do redesign their workflows.
title: McKinsey: 40% of large firms scale agents, 37% see profit
